title: Duke Ellington in a class by himself
summary: Ellington had hits from his own compositions before any of the others.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Of course, Duke always did have -- I have to exclude Duke when I talk about big bands and things because Duke to me was in a class by himself always, you know, and I think that's how all of us musicians looked upon Duke, because way back when, before any of us doing anything with recordings, Duke had hit records going, you know, way back.

But -- and they mostly -- most of those things was his own compositions, his own material, you know. I remember when he -- almost every month would have a hit record on one of his own tunes -- 'In My Solitude' or 'Sophisticated Lady,' things of this sort, going way back there then, even before Strayhorn -- even before Billy Strayhorn ever got with Duke, Duke had a lot of those things going.
When did you first here or Duke? (Inaudible)?
